p.i: A revelation given at Kirtland, Ohio, 22–23 September 1832, through Joseph Smith Jr.

chapter.li: LEChapter84 Verse1 A revelation of Jesus Christ unto his servant Joseph Smith Jr. and six elders, as they united their hearts in lifting their voice on high. VerseEnd Verse2 Yea, the word of the Lord concerning his church established in the last days, for the restoration of his people as he has spoken by the mouth of his prophets, and for the gathering of his saints to stand upon Mount Zion, which shall be called the city New Jerusalem, VerseEnd Verse3 which city shall be built beginning at the temple lot, which is appointed by the finger of the Lord in the western boundaries of the state of Missouri, and dedicated by the hand of Joseph Smith Jr. and others with whom the Lord was well pleased. VerseEnd

Verse4 Truly, this is the word of the Lord — that the city New Jerusalem shall be built by the gathering of the saints, beginning at this place, even the place of the temple, which temple shall be reared in this generation. VerseEnd

Verse5 For truly, this generation shall not all pass away until a house shall be built unto the Lord and a cloud shall rest upon it, which cloud shall be even the glory of the Lord, which shall fill the house VerseEnd Verse6 and the sons of Moses, according to the Holy Priesthood which he received under the hand of his father-in-law, Jethro. VerseEnd
Verse7 And Jethro received it under the hand of Caleb. VerseEnd
Verse8 And Caleb received it under the hand of Elihu. VerseEnd
Verse9 And Elihu under the hand of Jeremy. VerseEnd
Verse10 And Jeremy under the hand of Gad. VerseEnd
Verse11 And Gad under the hand of Esaias. VerseEnd
Verse12 And Esaias received it under the hand of God. VerseEnd

Verse13 Esaias also lived in the days of Abraham and was blessed of him, VerseEnd Verse14 which Abraham received the Priesthood from Melchizedek, who received it through the lineage of his fathers, even till Noah, VerseEnd Verse15 and from Noah till Enoch, through the lineage of their fathers, VerseEnd Verse16 and from Enoch to Abel who was slain by the conspiracy of his brother, who received the Priesthood by the commandment of God, by the hand of his father Adam, who was the first man, VerseEnd Verse17 which Priesthood continues in the church of God in all generations, and is without beginning of days or end of years. VerseEnd

Verse18 And the Lord confirmed a priesthood also upon Aaron and his seed throughout all their generations, which priesthood also continues and abides for ever, with the Priesthood which is after the holiest Order of God. VerseEnd

Verse19 And this greater Priesthood administers the gospel and holds the key of the mysteries of the kingdom, even the key of the knowledge of God. VerseEnd Verse20 Therefore, in the ordinances thereof the power of godliness is manifest, VerseEnd Verse21 and without the ordinances thereof, and the authority of the Priesthood, the power of godliness is not manifest unto man in the flesh, VerseEnd Verse22 for without this no man can see the face of God, even the Father, and live. VerseEnd

Verse23 Now, this, Moses plainly taught to the children of Israel in the wilderness, and sought diligently to sanctify his people that they might behold the face of God, VerseEnd Verse24 but they hardened their hearts and could not endure his presence. Therefore, the Lord, in his wrath (for his anger was kindled against them) swore that they should not enter into his rest — which rest is the fullness of his glory — while in the wilderness. VerseEnd

Verse25 Therefore, he took Moses out of their midst, and the Holy Priesthood also. VerseEnd Verse26 And the lesser priesthood continued, which priesthood holds the key of the ministering of angels, and the preparatory gospel, VerseEnd Verse27 which gospel is the gospel of repentance, and of baptism, and the remission of sins, and the law of carnal commandments, which the Lord in his wrath caused to continue with the house of Aaron, among the children of Israel, until John, whom God raised up, being filled with the holy ghost from his mother’s womb. VerseEnd Verse28 For he was baptized while he was yet in his childhood, and was ordained by the angel of God at the time he was eight days old unto this power: to overthrow the kingdom of the Jews, and to make straight the way of the Lord before the face of his people, to prepare them for the coming of the Lord, in whose hand is given all power. VerseEnd

Verse29 And again, the offices of elder and bishop are necessary appendages belonging unto the high priesthood. VerseEnd Verse30 And again, the offices of teacher and deacon are necessary appendages belonging to the lesser priesthood, which priesthood was confirmed upon Aaron and his sons. VerseEnd

Verse31 Therefore, as I said concerning the sons of Moses, for the sons of Moses and also the sons of Aaron shall offer an acceptable offering and sacrifice in the house of the Lord, which house shall be built unto the Lord in this generation upon the consecrated spot as I have appointed. VerseEnd Verse32 And the sons of Moses and of Aaron shall be filled with the glory of the Lord upon Mount Zion, in the Lord’s house, whose sons are ye, and also many whom I have called and sent forth to build up my church. VerseEnd Verse33 For whoever is faithful unto the obtaining these two priesthoods of which I have spoken, and the magnifying their calling, are sanctified by the spirit unto the renewing of their bodies, VerseEnd Verse34 that they become the sons of Moses and of Aaron, and the seed of Abraham, and the church, and kingdom, and the elect of God. VerseEnd

Verse35 And also, all they who receive this Priesthood receive me, says the Lord, VerseEnd Verse36 for he that receives my servants receives me, VerseEnd Verse37 and he that receives me receives my Father, VerseEnd Verse38 and he that receives my Father receives my Father’s kingdom; therefore, all that my Father has shall be given unto him. VerseEnd Verse39 And this is according to the oath and the covenant which belongs to the Priesthood. VerseEnd Verse40 Therefore, all those who receive the Priesthood receive this oath and covenant of my Father, which he cannot break, neither can it be moved. VerseEnd Verse41 But whoever breaks this covenant after he has received it, and altogether turns therefrom, shall not have forgiveness in this world, nor in the world to come, VerseEnd Verse42 and all those who come not unto this Priesthood which you have received, which I now confirm upon you who are present this day, namely the twenty-third day of September, A.D. 1832, eleven high priests, save one, by my own voice out of the Heavens. And even I have given the Heavenly host and my angels charge concerning you. VerseEnd

Verse43 And I now give unto you a commandment to beware concerning yourselves, to give diligent heed to the words of eternal life, VerseEnd Verse44 for you shall live by every word that proceeds forth from the mouth of God. VerseEnd Verse45 For the word of the Lord is truth, and whatever is truth is light, and whatever is light is spirit, even the spirit of Jesus Christ. VerseEnd Verse46 And the spirit gives light to every man that comes into the world, and the spirit enlightens every man through the world that hearkens to the voice of the spirit, VerseEnd Verse47 and everyone that hearkens to the voice of the spirit comes unto God, even the Father. VerseEnd Verse48 And the Father teaches him of the covenant which the Father has renewed and confirmed upon you, which is confirmed upon you for your sakes, and not for yours only, but for the sake of the whole world. VerseEnd

Verse49 And the whole world lies in sin and groans under darkness and under the bondage of sin, VerseEnd Verse50 and by this you may know they are under the bondage of sin, because they come not unto me, VerseEnd Verse51 for whoever comes not unto me is under the bondage of sin. VerseEnd Verse52 And whoever receives not my voice is not acquainted with my voice and is not of me. VerseEnd Verse53 And by this you may know the righteous from the wicked, and that the whole world groans under sin and darkness, even now. VerseEnd

Verse54 And your minds in times past have been darkened because of unbelief, and because you have treated lightly the things you have received, VerseEnd Verse55 which vanity and unbelief have brought the whole church under condemnation. VerseEnd Verse56 And this condemnation rests upon the children of Zion, even all, VerseEnd Verse57 and they shall remain under this condemnation until they repent and remember the new covenant, even the Book of Mormon, and the former commandments which I have given them, not only to say but to do according to that which I have written, VerseEnd Verse58 that they may bring forth fruit meet for their Father’s kingdom. Otherwise, there remains a scourge and a judgment to be poured out upon the children of Zion, VerseEnd Verse59 for shall the children of the kingdom pollute my holy land? Truly, truly I say unto you, Nay. VerseEnd

Verse60 Truly, truly I say unto you who now hear my words, which is my voice, blessed are you inasmuch as you receive these things. VerseEnd Verse61 For I will forgive you of your sins with this commandment — that you remain steadfast in your minds, in solemnity and the spirit of prayer, in bearing testimony to all the world of those things which are communicated unto you. VerseEnd Verse62 Therefore, go into all the world, and whatever place you cannot go into you shall send, that the testimony may go from you into all the world, unto every creature. VerseEnd Verse63 And as I said unto my apostles, even so I say unto you, for you are my apostles, even God’s high priests. You are they whom my Father has given me. You are my friends. VerseEnd Verse64 Therefore, as I said unto my apostles, I say unto you again, that every soul who believes on your words and is baptized by water for the remission of their sins shall receive the holy ghost. VerseEnd

Verse65 And these signs shall follow them that believe: VerseEnd Verse66 in my name they shall do many wonderful works; VerseEnd Verse67 in my name they shall cast out devils; VerseEnd Verse68 in my name they shall heal the sick; VerseEnd Verse69 in my name they shall open the eyes of the blind and unstop the ears of the deaf, VerseEnd Verse70 and the tongue of the dumb shall speak; VerseEnd Verse71 and if any man shall administer poison unto them, it shall not hurt them; VerseEnd Verse72 and the poison of a serpent shall not have power to harm them. VerseEnd Verse73 But a commandment I give unto them that they shall not boast themselves of these things, neither speak them before the world, for these things are given unto you for your profit and for salvation. VerseEnd

Verse74 Truly, truly I say unto you, they who believe not on your words, and are not baptized by water in my name for the remission of their sins that they may receive the holy ghost, shall be damned and shall not come into my Father’s kingdom where my Father and I am. VerseEnd Verse75 And this revelation unto you, and commandment, is in force from this very hour, upon all the world. And the gospel is unto all who have not received it. VerseEnd Verse76 But truly I say unto all those to whom the kingdom has been given, from you it must be preached unto them that they shall repent of their former evil works, for they are to be upbraided for their evil hearts of unbelief, and your brethren in Zion for their rebellion against you at the time I sent you. VerseEnd

Verse77 And again, I say unto you my friends, for from this time forth I shall call you friends, it is expedient that I give unto you this commandment that you become even as my friends in days when I was with them, traveling to preach this gospel in my power. VerseEnd Verse78 For I suffered them not to have purse or scrip, neither two coats. VerseEnd Verse79 Behold, I send you out to prove the world, and the laborer is worthy of his hire, VerseEnd Verse80 and any man that shall go and preach this gospel of the kingdom and fail not to continue faithful in all things, shall not be weary in mind, neither darkened, neither in body, limb, or joint. And a hair of his head shall not fall to the ground unnoticed. And he shall not go hungry, neither athirst. VerseEnd

Verse81 Therefore, take no thought for the morrow, for what you shall eat, or what you shall drink, or wherewith you shall be clothed. VerseEnd Verse82 For consider the lilies of the field, how they grow: they toil not, neither do they spin, and the kingdoms of the world, in all their glory, are not arrayed like one of these. VerseEnd Verse83 For your Father who is in Heaven knows that you have need of all these things. VerseEnd Verse84 Therefore, let the morrow take thought for the things of itself. VerseEnd Verse85 Neither take you thought beforehand what you shall say, but treasure up in your minds continually the words of life, and it shall be given you in the very hour that portion that shall be meted unto every man. VerseEnd

Verse86 Therefore, let no man among you, for this commandment is unto all the faithful who are called of God in the church unto the ministry, therefore, let no man from this hour take purse or scrip that goes forth to proclaim this gospel of the kingdom. VerseEnd Verse87 Behold, I send you out to reprove the world of all their unrighteous deeds, and to teach them of a judgment which is to come. VerseEnd Verse88 And whoever receives you, there I will be also, for I will go before your face. I will be on your right hand and on your left, and my spirit shall be in your hearts, and my angels round about you to bear you up. VerseEnd

Verse89 Whoever receives you receives me, and the same will feed you, and clothe you, and give you money. VerseEnd Verse90 And he who feeds you, or clothes you, or gives you money shall in no wise lose his reward. VerseEnd Verse91 And he that does not these things is not my disciple; by this you may know my disciple. VerseEnd Verse92 He that receives you not, go away from him, alone by yourselves, and cleanse your feet, even with water, pure water, whether in heat or in cold, and bear testimony of it unto your Father which is in Heaven, and return not again unto that man. VerseEnd Verse93 And in whatever village or city you enter, do likewise. VerseEnd Verse94 Nevertheless, search diligently and spare not. And woe unto that house, or that village or city that rejects you, or your words or testimony concerning me. VerseEnd Verse95 Woe, I say again, unto that house, or that village or city that rejects you, or your words or your testimony of me. VerseEnd Verse96 For I, the Almighty, have laid my hand upon the nations to scourge them for their wickedness. VerseEnd Verse97 And plagues shall go forth, and they shall not be taken from the earth until I have completed my work, which shall be cut short in righteousness, VerseEnd Verse98 until all shall know me who remain, even from the least unto the greatest, and shall be filled with the knowledge of the Lord, and shall see eye to eye, and shall lift up their voice, and with the voice together sing this new song, saying: VerseEnd

Verse99 The Lord has brought again Zion. The Lord has redeemed his people Israel according to the election of grace, which was brought to pass by the faith and covenant of their Fathers. VerseEnd Verse100 The Lord has redeemed his people, and Satan is bound, and time is no longer. The Lord has gathered all things in one. The Lord has brought down Zion from above, the Lord has brought up Zion from beneath. VerseEnd Verse101 The earth has travailed and brought forth her strength, and truth is established in her bowels, and the Heavens have smiled upon her, and she is clothed with the glory of her God, for he stands in the midst of his people. VerseEnd Verse102 Glory, and honor, and power, and might be ascribed to our God, for he is full of mercy, justice, grace, and truth, and peace, for ever and ever. Amen. VerseEnd

Verse103 Again, truly, truly I say unto you, it is expedient that every man who goes forth to proclaim my everlasting gospel, that inasmuch as they have families and receive moneys by gift, that they should send it unto them or make use of it for their benefit, as the Lord shall direct them, for thus it seems good to me. VerseEnd Verse104 And let all those who have not families, who receive moneys, send it up unto the bishop in Zion or unto the bishop in Ohio, that it may be consecrated for the bringing forth of the revelations, and the printing thereof, and for establishing Zion. VerseEnd Verse105 And if any shall give unto any of you a coat or a suit, take the old and cast it unto the poor and go your way rejoicing. VerseEnd

Verse106 And if any man among you be strong in the spirit, let him take with him he that is weak, that he may be edified in all meekness, that he may become strong also. VerseEnd Verse107 Therefore, take with you those who are ordained unto the lesser priesthood, and send them before you to make appointments, and to prepare the way, and to fill appointments that you yourselves are not able to fill. VerseEnd Verse108 Behold, this is the way that my apostles in ancient days built up my church unto me. VerseEnd

Verse109 Therefore, let every man stand in his own office and labor in his own calling, and let not the head say unto the feet it has no need of the feet, for without the feet, how shall the body be able to stand? VerseEnd Verse110 Also, the body has need of every member, that all may be edified together, that the system may be kept perfect. VerseEnd Verse111 And behold, the high priest should travel, and also the elders, and also the lesser priests, but the deacons and teachers should be appointed to watch over the church, to be standing ministers unto the church. VerseEnd Verse112 And the bishop also should travel round about and among all the churches, searching after the poor to administer to their wants by humbling the rich and the proud. VerseEnd Verse113 He should also employ an agent, to take charge and to do his secular business, as he shall direct. VerseEnd

Verse114 Nevertheless, let the bishop go unto the City of New York, and also to the City of Albany, and also to the City of Boston, and warn the people of those cities with the sound of the gospel, with a loud voice, of the desolation and utter abolishment which awaits them if they do reject these things. VerseEnd Verse115 For, if they do reject these things, the hour of their judgment is near and their house shall be left unto them desolate. VerseEnd Verse116 Let him trust in me and he shall not be confounded, and a hair of his head shall not fall to the ground unnoticed. VerseEnd

Verse117 And truly I say unto you, the rest of my servants, go forth as your circumstances shall permit in your several callings, unto the great and notable cities and villages, reproving the world in righteousness of all their unrighteous and ungodly deeds, setting forth clearly and understandably the desolation of abomination in the last days. VerseEnd Verse118 For with you, says the Lord Almighty, I will rend their kingdoms. I will not only shake the earth, but the starry heavens shall tremble VerseEnd Verse119 also. For I, the Lord, have put forth my hand to exert the Powers of Heaven. You cannot see it now; yet a little while and you shall see it and know that I Am, and that I will come and reign with my people. VerseEnd Verse120 I am Alpha and Omega, the Beginning and the End. Amen. VerseEnd
